tools.name: search_spectra
tools.description: Search the MARY-DATA catalog by metadata (text, domain, license, Oklab proximity). Returns record summaries — fetch full spectral values with get_spectrum.

tools.name: get_spectrum
tools.description: Fetch full spectral values (380–750 nm, 10 nm grid) plus provenance for up to 50 records by ID.

tools.name: convert_color_space
tools.description: Convert colors or spectra between spaces (spd/record/srgb/xyz/oklab → xyz/oklab/srgb). Batch-capable; sRGB results report out-of-gamut flags instead of clipping silently.

tools.name: compute_delta_e
tools.description: Perceptual difference ΔE_OK (Oklab) between colors: full pairwise matrix or consecutive pairs, optionally as seen under a color vision deficiency. Highlights the closest pair.

tools.name: simulate_cvd
tools.description: Simulate color vision deficiency (Machado 2009 physiological model) on colors: protan/deutan/tritan at severity 0–1.

tools.name: compensate_cvd
tools.description: Remap a palette for discriminability under a color vision deficiency (constrained daltonization in Oklab). NOTE: remaps for discriminability; cannot restore information lost to dichromacy. Errors with the achievable bound when constraints are infeasible.

tools.name: render_telemetry_palette
tools.description: Generate an N-class palette with a guaranteed minimum ΔE_OK under normal vision AND every listed CVD profile. Default floor 0.15 is safety-critical grade (JND≈0.02) — feasible class counts are small by design; on infeasibility the error reports what was achievable.

tools.name: detect_photopeaks
tools.description: Detect gamma-ray photopeaks in a pulse-height spectrum (SNIP continuum + significance test); with an energy calibration, returns ranked isotope candidates. Decision support only — not an authoritative isotope identification.

tools.name: check_gamut
tools.description: Test whether colors are physically realizable surface colors (inside the MacAdam object-color solid) under an illuminant. Returns signed margins.

tools.name: compute_macadam_solid
tools.description: Build the full MacAdam object-color solid mesh (two-transition optimal colors) for an illuminant, in XYZ or Oklab.

tools.name: expand_spectrum_basis
tools.description: Project spectra (spd or record inputs) onto a Chebyshev functional basis; returns compact coefficients plus reconstruction error.

tools.name: synthesize_spectrum
tools.description: Reconstruct spectra from Chebyshev coefficients on any wavelength grid; optionally apply the analytic derivative first.

tools.name: get_dataset_info
tools.description: Dataset snapshot statistics: record counts per domain/source, licenses, snapshot ID.

tools.name: estimate_cct
tools.description: Correlated color temperature (CCT) and Duv for light sources: nearest point on the Planckian locus in CIE 1960 UCS with parabolic refinement. |Duv| > 0.05 flags chromaticities where CCT is not meaningful.

tools.name: adapt_chromatic
tools.description: Chromatic adaptation (CAT16 von Kries): predict how a color seen under one illuminant appears under another. Degree 0-1 controls adaptation completeness.

tools.name: find_dominant_wavelength
tools.description: Dominant wavelength and excitation purity (CIE definitions): the monochromatic hue match for a color. Purples report a complementary wavelength instead.

tools.name: sample_metamers
tools.description: Sample the metamer set: physically valid reflectances that all match a target color exactly under an illuminant (convex-set framework, Logvinenko/Godau-Funt). Returns center, boundary samples, and a per-wavelength envelope. Errors NO_SOLUTION for unrealizable targets.

tools.name: estimate_spectrum
tools.description: Reconstruct a plausible reflectance spectrum from a color (smoothest metamer, curvature-minimizing). NOTE: one of infinitely many metamers — not the 'true' spectrum of any particular object.

tools.name: decompose_spectrum
tools.description: Decompose a spectrum into Gaussian peaks + flat baseline (Levenberg-Marquardt fit). For emission/fluorescence band analysis; returns centers, widths (FWHM), amplitudes, and fit R².

tools.name: certify_palette_ceiling
tools.description: How good can ANY N-color palette possibly be? Computes a certified upper bound on achievable minimum pairwise ΔE_OK (worst case across CVD profiles) via a covering argument over the gamut, paired with a constructed witness palette as the lower bound — the true optimum is bracketed. Published figures are one-observer napkin estimates; this is computed for your exact case.

tools.name: solve_spectral_constraints
tools.description: Spectral constraint oracle: does a physical reflectance exist showing color A under illuminant 1, color B under illuminant 2, ... within tolerances? Returns a verified witness spectrum, or an infeasibility report naming the smallest conflicting constraint subsets. Nearest prior art generates multi-condition metamers when they exist; the decision procedure with conflict localization is the new part.

tools.name: could_be_same_surface
tools.description: Forensic corollary of the constraint oracle: could two (illuminant, color) observations be the SAME physical surface? Answers with a witness reflectance or a physical impossibility finding. Fluorescent or emissive materials are outside the bound and stated so.

tools.name: audit_color_transform
tools.description: Behavioral audit of a color transform supplied as a 3D LUT lattice (.cube order): gray-axis tone reversals, neutral contamination, hue flips beyond 25 degrees, outputs escaping [0,1], and local tears. LUT viewers show you the transform; this systematically tests what a sane transform must never do.

tools.name: diff_spectral_datasets
tools.description: Perceptual + forensic diff of two spectral dataset versions. Classifies every changed record (renoised / smoothed / rescaled / replaced), reports perceptual impact under D65, and returns a CI gate that fails on silent post-processing of claimed measurements.

tools.name: certify_blend_safety
tools.description: The convex core of the sRGB gamut in Oklab: a verified shrink factor inside which ANY linear blend (gradients, midpoints, crossfades) stays in gamut. Gamut non-convexity is well documented; the guarantee object for safe interpolation was never built. Sampled certificate with stated density.

tools.name: audit_image_physicality
tools.description: Physical impossibility certificate per pixel: which supplied sRGB pixels cannot be diffuse surface colors under ANY illuminant of a declared family, at a given exposure. Reports per-pixel overshoot (how over-bright each is for any physical surface). Fluorescence and emissive sources legitimately exceed the bound — output says not-a-plain-surface, never fake.

tools.name: crosscheck_color_implementations
tools.description: Metamorphic + differential testing for color implementations. Checks algebraic identities any correct implementation must satisfy (round-trip identity, gamut-map idempotence, adaptation white preservation, metamer tristimulus preservation, ΔE metric axioms, spectral linearity), shrinking failures to a minimal witness. Pass another library's outputs as external_results to diff implementations.

tools.name: certify_illuminant_robustness
tools.description: Certificate that a set of surfaces stays mutually discriminable under EVERY illuminant in the convex family you specify — not a sampled estimate. Exploits the fact that XYZ is linear in the illuminant, so the reachable response set is exactly the convex hull of basis responses; a Lipschitz bound covers the nonlinear Oklab step. Basis accepts D65/D50/A/E, BB<kelvin>, LED<nm>.

tools.name: generate_metamer_benchmark
tools.description: Generate a benchmark of physically realizable metameric confusions: pairs of valid surface reflectances identical under one illuminant and divergent under another. Every item is realizable — no pixel perturbation. Complements lighting-parameter attack benchmarks, which perturb the lamp rather than the surface.

tools.name: audit_colormap_corpus
tools.description: Audit a corpus of colormaps for topological faithfulness — whether each invents or destroys features — across normal and CVD observers, ranked by worst offender. Existing corpus studies check CVD accessibility; this checks whether the visualization tells the truth about the data's structure.

tools.name: generate_conformance_vectors
tools.description: Emit certified numeric test vectors for colorimetric transforms with documented formulae and tolerances, or score a candidate implementation against them. ICC conformance validates profile structure, not computation. This is a REFERENCE suite (this engine is the oracle), so a disagreement means one of the two implementations has a defect to explain.

tools.name: typecheck_color_pipeline
tools.description: Static checker for color pipeline specifications. Tracks encoding, color space, and illuminant through an op list and flags the classic silent-corruption bugs: matrix applied to gamma-encoded values, double transfer function, resampling in a nonlinear encoding, missing or mismatched chromatic adaptation.

tools.name: design_spectral_palette
tools.description: Design N reflectance SPECTRA (not colors) whose separation holds jointly across every listed illuminant × observer condition. A palette designed in a color space is only safe under the illuminant it was designed for — metamerism breaks it when lighting changes; designing the physical spectra fixes that. Errors with the achieved bound when the target is unreachable.

tools.name: design_discrimination_test
tools.description: Design a spectrally-realizable color-vision test stimulus: a reflectance pair a normal trichromat separates easily but the target deficiency cannot. Pseudoisochromatic plates are still constructed by trial and error; this optimizes the stimulus directly from spectra. Research tool, not a validated clinical screening test.

tools.name: synthesize_adversarial_spectrum
tools.description: Find a physically realizable illuminant that collapses a palette's separation for a human observer — an adversarial light. Published adversarial color work attacks CNNs in pixel space; this attacks a colorimetric system with a real light source. Returns the attack SPD, the degradation factor, and which pair collapsed.

tools.name: audit_colormap_topology
tools.description: Certificate of whether a colormap invents or destroys features. A colormap is topologically faithful exactly when its perceived lightness profile is monotone; each interior extremum turns a data level set into a ridge the viewer sees but the data lacks. Reports monotonicity violations plus spurious/lost feature counts from persistent homology, per observer including CVD.

tools.name: audit_spectrum_provenance
tools.description: Measurement forensics: is this reflectance curve a real measurement, or interpolated/smoothed/synthesized? Detects missing instrument noise floor, interpolation signatures, value quantization, and clamped extrapolation tails. Triage signal only — thresholds are calibrated on synthetic negatives, not validated against verified instrument data.

tools.name: map_metamer_stratification
tools.description: Map how the SHAPE of the metamer set changes across color space: active box constraints and free extent along a path, with detected transitions. Shows where metamerism is geometrically rich versus where a color is nearly spectrally determined. Sampled stratification, not exact face-lattice enumeration.

tools.name: map_to_gamut
tools.description: Map colors into the sRGB gamut perceptually: preserve Oklch lightness and hue, compress chroma to the gamut boundary. Reports what was changed.
